parking_page.short_quote: Unless otherwise permitted by RTD, parking a vehicle in Park-n-Rides without use of the RTD transit system is prohibited
observations: RTD describes Park-n-Rides as for transit passengers and warns that violating parking rules or fees can lead to penalties or towing.
The parking-fee page lists 38th and Blake Station. Parking without transit use requires RTD permission.
The operator identifies 38th / Blake Station as a Rail Station Park-n-Ride with paid parking at 3737 Blake St, Denver, 80205, with 200 parking spaces.
For in-district vehicles the page states the first 24 hours are free, then $2 per day; out-of-district vehicles cost $4 per day. Parking must be paid before boarding.

limitations: This is an operator publication captured now, not a finding that these conditions applied at the fixed 2026-10-28 reference instant.
Parking conditions are not proof of a prohibition on vehicle entry, pickup or drop-off.
No exact entrance coordinate, current posted turn control, complete physical or same-grade path, connector cost or multi-city anchor-set completeness is established.
